checkpoints.note: The staged witness is admitted far enough that the top-level Variant resolves namespace-0 DataType NodeId 22 to `ExtensionObject` and dispatches the top-level `Body` into `Variant_decodeJsonUnwrapExtensionObject()` instead of being rejected before the vulnerable helper runs.

The attacker-controlled top-level `"Type":22` field is converted into namespace-0 DataType dispatch state here. On the witnessed path, numeric type id 22 resolves to the built-in `ExtensionObject` type and is stored in `dst->type`, which is the state that sends the Variant body into the vulnerable unwrap helper.

Error cleanup frees the allocated unwrapped body structure but does not clear `dst->data`. The fixing commit adds `dst->data = NULL;` immediately after this free, so later `UA_deleteMembers()` / `Variant_clear()` cleanup on the same partially built Variant no longer reuses the freed pointer.
